verdict.rationale: Docs confirm AvaTax supports exemption logic in tax calculation (avalara-docs-14) and can explain exemption status during calculation breakdowns (avalara-docs-28), plus Exemption Certificate Management/CertCapture for storing certificate data (avalara-docs-11, avalara-docs-32) and Managed Returns API for filing (avalara-docs-31). However no evidence explicitly shows an API field/parameter for marking a transaction/customer exempt with a reason code, nor that this reason is threaded through into the filed return output. missing for 10: explicit API parameter for exemption reason on CreateTransaction, documented linkage from exemption flag through to filed-return line items, and independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end reporting.
